findings.title: Secondhand rumor of dropped rows in large exports (hearsay, no repro)
findings.description: Customer relays a secondhand, wine-fueled conference anecdote from an L&D contact at a different (unnamed) company, who said 'large exports drop rows.' Customer has no first-hand experience — she does not run large exports herself and never saw the issue occur. No account, size threshold, or repro was provided; internal team explicitly declines to file anything on this basis and instead offers to check internally and validate a real export with the customer if/when she runs one.
findings.quote: she says something like "just watch out when you pull big exports, we've heard they drop rows sometimes."
findings.severity_reason: Unverified secondhand hearsay with zero first-hand evidence; no actionable defect to size.
findings.match_note: Superficially resembles a data-integrity bug but fails the first-hand-EXTERNAL-report bar; not the same as any catalogued export issue.

findings.title: Customer requests help building an engagement-to-retention ROI story for leadership
findings.description: Customer wants to tie coaching engagement data to retention more explicitly to justify program spend to her managing partner and head of finance in Q3. This is a request for BetterBark's team to help build reporting frameworks/materials, not a request for a new product capability or a fix to an existing one.
findings.quote: Send me whatever you've got. Q3 I have to justify the spend again and "people seem happier" won't cut it this year.
findings.severity_reason: Services/advisory request, not a product defect or feature gap.
findings.match_note: Distinct from PROJ-118 (PDF export of the existing manager dashboard view); this is a request for custom analysis/framework materials, not a product export feature.

findings.title: Customer requests access to an L&D peer community/newsletter
findings.description: Customer asks whether BetterBark offers a peer community or newsletter for people in her L&D role, wanting year-round connection with peers. Internal staff confirms this exists and offers to add her. This is a customer-community/program ask, not a product feature or defect.
findings.quote: do you all do anything for L&D teams like mine directly? Like a peer community or a newsletter? I feel starved for people who do exactly my job.
findings.severity_reason: Program/community request unrelated to the software product itself.
findings.match_note: No catalogued issue covers customer community programs; request was already satisfiable with an existing (non-product) offering.
